sections.title: What you know
sections.content: You know *célszerű* and *indokolt* from B2 Unit 29, and the infinitive after a need adjective from earlier units. This lesson adds *elengedhetetlen* ('indispensable') and *nélkülözhetetlen*: they say that something is a must for a whole system.

sections.title: Naming who must act
sections.content: If you name who must act, put the person in the dative and give the infinitive a personal ending: *A mérnököknek elengedhetetlen felkészülniük.* ('It is indispensable for the engineers to prepare.')

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Elengedhetetlen biztosítani az áramellátást a kórházakban.
It is indispensable to ensure the power supply in hospitals.
Célszerű tartalék rendszereket kiépíteni a hálózaton.
It is advisable to build reserve systems on the network.
A mérnököknek elengedhetetlen felkészülniük a támadásokra.
It is indispensable for the engineers to prepare for attacks.
